comment: uhitm.c mhitm_ad_wrap() 3346-3372, hero branch: a hero polymorphed into a giant eel touches shriekers (AT_TUCH AD_WRAP). find_roll_to_hit() leaves gn.notonhead FALSE for a head hit, so tailmiss (= !gn.notonhead) is TRUE and C prints 'You brush against the shrieker's tail.' instead of trying m_slips_free(); a tail hit (notonhead TRUE) is refused earlier by failed_grab(). This is why m_slips_free() 2065-2070 (AD_WRAP armor choice) cannot run for the hero.
